claim_tested: Human FUNDC1 binds LC3 through an N-terminal LIR Y18xxL21
key_finding: FUNDC1 interacts with LC3 via Y(18)xxL(21); LIR mutation impairs LC3 binding and mitophagy
context: Human cells (HeLa/MEF), hypoxia and FCCP; co-IP, GST pulldown, point mutants
confidence_limitations: High for human. Says nothing about nematodes; this is the motif whose conservation was tested.

claim_tested: Ser17 phosphorylation by ULK1 regulates the FUNDC1 LIR
key_finding: ULK1 phosphorylates FUNDC1 Ser17, enhancing LC3 binding
context: Human cells, hypoxia/uncoupler; kinase assay, phospho-mutants
confidence_limitations: High for human. Defines the regulatory phospho-site whose nematode counterpart was sought and not found.

claim_tested: Annotated LIR and regulatory sites in human FUNDC1
key_finding: Motif 18-21 YXXL; Modified residue S13 (CK2), S17 (ULK1), Y18 (SRC); Mutagenesis 17/18/20/21 impair MAP1LC3 binding
confidence_limitations: Database-level; traces to PMID:22267086, 24671035 and CK2/SRC papers.

citation: This work (Clustal Omega, EBI REST; 20 FUN14 proteins)
claim_tested: A LIR equivalent to YEVL exists at the orthologous position in nematodes
key_finding: YEVL/YEVV in 6/6 vertebrate FUNDC1, FESL in human FUNDC2, absent in 12/12 nematode FUN14 proteins (gaps or K/S/M/R at the aligned columns)
context: UniProt PF04930 sequence set; EBI Clustal Omega job clustalo-R20261123
confidence_limitations: Alignment of a short divergent N-terminal tail; gap placement in tails is the weakest part of any MSA. Mitigated by the independent de novo regex scan and the DCT-1 positive control.

citation: This work (regex scan + Monte Carlo null)
claim_tested: FNDC-1 carries a credible LIR anywhere in its cytosolic regions
key_finding: Only candidate in the N-terminal tail is YYVV(27-30), upstream DTVL (1/4 acidic). P(>=1 such motif by chance in a 36-aa tail) = 0.21 vs 0.004 for the FUNDC1 DDDS-YEVL configuration
context: Q22252 full-length scan by topological compartment; 20,000 Monte Carlo draws at C. elegans amino-acid composition
confidence_limitations: Regex plus flank heuristic, not a trained PSSM; iLIR/hfAIM web servers were not called programmatically. Non-canonical ATG8-binding modes (UDS, GIM) were not systematically tested.

claim_tested: The YYVV candidate is an evolutionarily maintained element
key_finding: C. briggsae/C. nigoni YVVD, C. tropicalis AIDL, C. japonica FIVD; zero [WFY]xx[LIV] hits in residues 1-40 of all four
confidence_limitations: High. Single-residue turnover across close congeners is the signature of a non-functional match.

claim_tested: The FNDC-1 candidate sits in a disordered, LIR-compatible context
confidence_limitations: pLDDT is a proxy for disorder, not a measurement. Modest difference; supporting, not decisive.

claim_tested: Nematode ATG8 proteins can engage LIR motifs at all
key_finding: LGG-1 and LGG-2 have structurally distinct LIR-binding pockets preferring different LIR residues
context: C. elegans, crystallography and binding assays
confidence_limitations: High. Rules out the alternative that nematodes lost LIR-based recognition generally.

claim_tested: The pipeline can detect a real conserved LIR in a C. elegans mitophagy receptor
key_finding: DCT-1 MSES-WVEL aligns exactly with Hs BNIP3 LQGS-WVEL and Hs BNIP3L/NIX LNSS-WVEL
confidence_limitations: High. Converts the FNDC-1 negative from 'not detected' to 'detected absent'.

claim_tested: fndc-1 has FUNDC1-like mitophagy function in worm
key_finding: fndc-1 is strongly expressed in sperm and contributes to paternal mitochondria elimination; paternal mtDNA detectable in cross-progeny of fndc-1 mutant males
context: C. elegans genetics, crosses, mtDNA qPCR, degradation kinetics
confidence_limitations: Loss-of-function phenotype only. No LGG-1/LGG-2 binding assay, no LIR mutant, so the molecular mechanism is not established.

claim_tested: FNDC-1 is the C. elegans FUNDC1 ortholog mediating mitophagy
key_finding: Loss of fndc-1 protects against hypoxia-reoxygenation injury via ATFS-1; transcript and metabolite remodeling on fndc-1 loss
context: C. elegans, HR injury model, RNA-seq and metabolomics
confidence_limitations: Orthology asserted functionally. Protection by loss of function is a downstream organismal outcome, not evidence of direct ATG8 binding.

claim_tested: fndc-1 is a one-to-one FUNDC1 ortholog licensing feature transfer
key_finding: Q22252 is 30.5% identical to FUNDC1, 32.6% to FUNDC2, 34.1% to yeast FUN14 (FUNDC1 vs FUNDC2 control 56.1%); single FUN14 gene in C. elegans; NJ places nematode FUN14 outside the FUNDC1/FUNDC2 split
context: BLOSUM62 global alignment; Kimura distances from a 15-sequence MSA
confidence_limitations: NJ on a ~100-residue domain at >1.7 substitutions/site has weak resolution; no bootstrap. The identity ranking and single-copy status are the firmer points.
